what: First loader — after .3s the large title rises from 130% below over 1s expo.out, and the italic word rises together .3s later, unscrambling from shuffled letters front to back. The counter rises after .9s, counts steadily from 86 to 93 over 1.5s, then reaches 100 in .5s. Once the text is all up, a curtain with a rounded top edge (the opposite stage from the background) fills from below over .9s expo.inOut to cover it — the text uses difference blending so it flips bright over the curtain — and when all three finish, the text lines leave in turn to -130% (.6s expo.inOut, each next line starting .55s before the previous one ends) and the curtain, bottom edge still rounded, lifts away upward over .9s expo.inOut while the body rises from 40px below at the same time.

options.rise · cover · out · lift: Rise, cover, drop-out and lift-off durations in seconds, default 1 · .9 · .6 · .9 — shorten for screens opened often
options.ramp: Count-up length from 86 to 93 on the counter (sec), default 1.5
options.page: Body selector that gets pushed up along as the cover lifts away (e.g. main)
options.shift: Distance the body was pushed (px), default 40
options.[data-fx-part=lines] > [data-fx-part=cli: Large title in a clipped line · italic word
options.--fx-base · --fx-mask · --fx-arc: Loader background, curtain color, rounded depth, default --kf-bg · --kf-contrast-bg · 60px
options.fx:done: Event raised once all have lifted
options.hold: Seconds the counter holds at 86~93, default 0 — the original holds until all of that page’s photos and videos are loaded (measured: Brand home 2.3 · Work 1.5 · About 2.75 · Contact .9)
options.glitch: If off, word-band glitching is turned off — default is .45s after the text appears, then a two-frame offset every 2.4s (±25%)
